items.title: ChatGPT Containers can now run bash, pip/npm install packages and download files
items.raw_content: One of my favourite features of ChatGPT is its ability to write and execute code in a container. This feature launched as ChatGPT Code Interpreter nearly three years ago, was …

items.title: Counterfactual Cultural Cues Reduce Medical QA Accuracy in LLMs: Identifier vs Context Effects
items.title_zh: 反事实文化线索降低大模型医疗问答准确率：身份标识与语境效应
items.summary: The paper introduces a counterfactual benchmark that expands 150 MedQA items into 1,650 variants with cultural identifier tokens and contextual cues. Across GPT-5.2, Llama-3.1-8B, DeepSeek-R1 and MedGemma, cultural cues significantly affected accuracy, with the largest degradation when identifier and context co-occurred.

items.title: Multi-task Code LLMs: Data Mix or Model Merge?
items.title_zh: 多任务代码 LLM：数据混合还是模型合并？
items.summary: The paper compares data mixing with model merging for building small multi-task code LLMs across Qwen Coder and DeepSeek Coder at 2B and 7B scales, finding that merging performs best at larger scale while data mixing is preferable at smaller scale. Its best merged Qwen Coder 2.5 7B configuration reached 92.7% Pass@1 on HumanEval versus 90.9% for the task-specific fine-tuned equivalent.

items.title: PyGALAX: An Open-Source Python Toolkit for Advanced Explainable Geospatial Machine Learning
items.title_zh: PyGALAX：面向地理空间机器学习的开源可解释 Python 工具包
items.summary: PyGALAX is an open-source Python package that pairs AutoML with SHAP-based explanations for geospatial regression and classification, extending the GALAX framework with automatic bandwidth selection and flexible kernel functions to handle spatial non-stationarity.

items.title: A Unifying View of Coverage in Linear Off-Policy Evaluation
items.title_zh: 线性离策略评估中覆盖度概念的统一视角
items.summary: The paper analyzes LSTDQ in linear off-policy evaluation under the minimal assumption that only the target value function is linearly realizable. It introduces a feature-dynamics coverage parameter and shows the bound recovers specialized coverage definitions under stronger assumptions such as Bellman completeness.

items.title: How does information access affect LLM monitors' ability to detect sabotage?
items.title_zh: 信息获取如何影响 LLM 监控器发现破坏行为的能力？
items.summary: The paper examines how information access affects LLM monitors' ability to detect sabotage and finds a 'less-is-more effect,' where monitors often perform better with less information. Its extract-and-evaluate approach improved sabotage detection by 16.8 percentage points in BigCodeBench-Sabotage with a GPT-4.1-mini monitor.

items.title: Brazilian Portuguese Image Captioning with Transformers: A Study on Cross-Native-Translated Dataset
items.title_zh: 基于 Transformer 的巴西葡萄牙语图像描述：跨母语-翻译数据集研究
items.summary: The study compares Transformer vision-language models on native Brazilian Portuguese Flickr30K captions versus machine-translated captions, finding that Swin-DistilBERTimbau generalizes best and ViTucano beats GPT-4o and LLaMA 3.2 Vision on text-based metrics, while GPT-4 models score highest on CLIP-Score.

items.title: Efficient Deep Learning for Medical Imaging: Bridging the Gap Between High-Performance AI and Clinical Deployment
items.title_zh: 医学影像的高效深度学习：弥合高性能 AI 与临床部署之间的差距
items.summary: This review surveys efficient, lightweight deep learning for medical imaging across CNNs, lightweight transformers and linear-complexity models, and examines pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation and low-rank factorization for cutting hardware requirements while preserving diagnostic performance.

items.title: Understanding vision transformer robustness through the lens of out-of-distribution detection
items.title_zh: 从分布外检测视角理解视觉 Transformer 的鲁棒性
items.summary: The authors investigate how quantized DeiT, DeiT3 and ViT models behave on out-of-distribution datasets, finding that 4-bit models trained on ImageNet-22k can degrade sharply, with DeiT3 dropping 17% from quantization error. OOD detection shows ImageNet-22k pretrained ViT and DeiT3 had average quantization deltas of 15.0% and 19.2% in AUPR-out, leading the authors to suggest large-scale pretraining may hinder low-bit robustness and that data augmentation may be more beneficial.

items.title: Specialists or Generalists? Multi-Agent and Single-Agent LLMs for Essay Grading
items.title_zh: 专家还是通才？用于作文评分的多智能体与单智能体 LLM
items.summary: Using the ASAP 2.0 corpus and GPT-5.1, the authors find that a multi-agent grading system was significantly better at identifying weak essays while a single-agent system performed better on mid-range essays, and that providing two examples per score level raised QWK by about 26% for both architectures.
